name: Praxis Capital
strategy: Global long/short equity — power, compute, and the physical substrate of the AI build-out
risk_rules: Core longs: review at −15% from entry; convex sleeve: hard stop at −25%.
Shorts: cover discipline at +30% adverse move. Max single-name short 3.5% of NAV; broad-index hedges (QQQ, IWM) are exempt from that cap and capped at 6.5% each.
Power & Grid sleeve capped at 36% of NAV; total AI-linked long exposure (Power & Grid + Compute Chokepoints) capped at 60% of NAV and must be carried against an index hedge of at least 8%.
Net exposure rebalanced back inside the 35–75% band whenever a mark closes outside it.
No position sized on momentum alone — every line carries a written thesis and an explicit falsifier.
disclaimer: Simulation only. No real capital, no brokerage account, no orders routed anywhere. Prices are delayed end-of-day marks from public sources. Nothing here is investment advice.
